executive_summary: Hove A/S successfully completed an IPO raising DKK 40 million to fund international expansion, achieved positive results of DKK 3.9 million despite inflation challenges, and established subsidiaries in India and Brazil while developing new IoT solutions.
key_highlights: Positive result of DKK 3.9 million with 5.5% profit margin
IPO on First North Growth Market raised DKK 40 million with 80% oversubscription
Cash position increased to DKK 25.5 million from DKK 2.3 million
Subsidiaries established in India and Brazil in late 2021
New CEO Maja Vonsild Jørgensen appointed with 25+ years combined management experience
First ESG report published, maintaining ISO 14001 certification
IoT solution Hove Smart Lube under development with DKK 12.9 million intangible assets
